ajuste.tooltip: Automatic follows the ComfyUI language (Comfy.Locale). The ES/EN button in the window changes this same setting.
app.agente.cambios.tooltip: Everything the agent touched has a pink «✎ agent» border. It goes away when you edit it or press «Seen».
app.agente.conflicto: The agent changed this project while you were editing. Which version do you keep?
app.agente.recargado: The agent changed the project: it is up to date (its changes say «✎ agent»)
app.agente.recargado_otro: The project changed in another tab: it is up to date
app.cola.avisos.tooltip: A short sound and a browser notification when each job and the whole queue finish
app.cola.ayuda: Each job keeps a snapshot of the project when queued: you can keep editing. The server runs them one by one even if you close the page.
app.cola.encolado: Queued: it will start when its turn comes
app.cola.encolar.tooltip: Queues several identical jobs with different random seeds; they run one by one
app.cola.n: How many jobs (each with another seed)
app.cola.reintentar: Retry (goes to the end of the queue)
app.cola.tooltip: Queued jobs: they run one by one, even if you close the page
app.cola.vacia: The queue is empty: press Generate or «Queue ×N».
app.error.comfyui: ComfyUI is not responding at {url}: start it and try again.
app.error.conflicto: «{nombre}» changed since you opened it (saved by the agent or another tab): nothing was overwritten
app.error.no_existe_trabajo: That job is no longer in the queue.
app.error.nombre: Invalid project name: use letters, numbers, spaces, - and _.
app.error.sin_generar: app/generar.py is missing: this copy of the app can't make videos yet.
app.error.sin_nodo: the template has no «Prompt del edit» node
app.error.sin_valores_video: this video did not save what it was generated with (it was made before Oct 29, or outside the queue)
app.error.solo_lectura: «{nombre}» is the example project and never changes: your edits go into a copy.
app.error.trabajador: The app's worker stopped (see app/servidor.log); it restarts on the next action.
app.error.ya_existe: There is already a project «{nombre}»: choose another name.
app.extender.alarga.ayuda: In steps of 17 frames (0.71 s), because H3 renders windows of 17n+5.
app.extender.audio.ayuda: By default the video's audio is kept.
app.extender.audio.explica.cancion: The song «{cancion}» carries on right where it was: it guides H3 and is laid back on top untouched.
app.extender.audio.explica.cancion_borra: The project's song is no longer in ComfyUI/input: H3 continues the sound of the last seconds.
app.extender.audio.explica.cancion_proye: Video without a noted song: using the one its project has NOW, «{cancion}». If you changed it, pick «Model audio».
app.extender.audio.explica.modelo: The original sounds the same; the new part sounds with what H3 generates following the last seconds.
app.extender.audio.explica.sin_cancion: I don't know which song plays (outside mp4 or model audio): the original keeps its sound and H3 continues the sound of its last seconds.
app.extender.audio.se_acaba: The song ends earlier: the last {s} s will be silent.
app.extender.boton.tooltip: Queue the extension with this seed
app.extender.calidad.media.ayuda: At ~0.5 MP: a middle point between time and sharpness.
app.extender.calidad.original.ayuda: At the video's resolution: the best join, and the only one that uses the saved latent; slower.
app.extender.calidad.rapida.ayuda: At ~0.25 MP: quick, good to check the motion; the new part looks softer.
app.extender.cargar.tooltip: Upload a video from your computer (an outside mp4) and put it here to extend it
app.extender.fuente.mp4: Continues from the mp4 (loses a little colour)
app.extender.fuente.por_que.latente_borr: Its saved latent is no longer in ComfyUI/output/latents.
app.extender.fuente.por_que.otra_resoluc: Its saved latent has another resolution: pick the quality it was made with to use it.
app.extender.fuente.por_que.retoque_fina: It is a retouch that changed the end of the video: the original's latent no longer fits.
app.extender.fuente.por_que.sin_latente: This video has no saved latent (it comes from outside or is older than Oct 28).
app.extender.linea.nuevo: New part: {f} f ({s} s). Drag the end handle to make it longer or shorter (17 f steps)
app.extender.linea.solape: Overlap: the last {f} f ({s} s) H3 looks at to continue. Drag the handle to change it
app.extender.listo_aviso: Extension ready: {video}. It is on the timeline in case you want to make it longer again
app.extender.pestana.extender.ayuda: Make the video longer, continuing the same shot with no cut
app.extender.pestana.inpaint.ayuda: Redo an area of a segment (erase, change, add detail)
app.extender.plan.memoria: Long window at this resolution: it may not fit in 12 GB. Try «medium» quality or extend less.
app.extender.plan.tamano: H3 renders {w}×{h} · {f} f (overlap + new) · about {lo}–{hi} min
app.extender.prompt.ayuda: In English, short: only what comes next. No shot or camera changes (that would be another shot).
app.extender.prompt.placeholder: Empty = same action, same camera. E.g.: she keeps looking up at the logo and breathes softly
app.extender.refs.ayuda: The video's last frame always goes as a reference already (the last <Picture N>). The project's references help keep colour and face from drifting (e.g. the logo): cite them as <Picture N>.
app.extender.solape: How much of the original H3 sees
app.extender.solape.ayuda: More overlap = follows the motion better but takes longer. 39 f is the only one exact on the audio grid.
app.extender.solape.ayuda_39: 39 f is recommended: it lands exactly on the audio grid and gives ~1.6 s of motion memory.
app.extender.vacio: Choose a video to make longer
app.extender.ver_solape.tooltip: Play the final part H3 looks at again (the overlap)
app.generar.sin_prompt: There is no prompt: write the plan first (Write story and Write shots, or the final prompt by hand).
app.generar.tooltip: Make the video with H3 in ComfyUI, using the final prompt below and the video seed
app.preview.ayuda: What H3 is doing, step by step: blurry at first, clearer with every step.
app.preview.sin_datos: No preview yet: does the template have the Model Preview Override node, and was ComfyUI restarted after updating the app?
app.preview.tooltip: Open or close the live preview: what H3 is generating, step by step (from the Model Preview Override node)
app.proyecto.ejemplo_copiado: The example opened as your own copy: «{nombre}». The original stays as it is.
app.proyecto.guardar_como.tooltip: Save a copy of this edit under another name and keep working on the copy
app.retocar.arrastra.tooltip: Drag it into the prompt to cite it
app.retocar.boton.tooltip: Redoes the covered area in the chosen segment and builds the full video with that segment replaced (the audio does not change)
app.retocar.cargar.tooltip: Load a finished video from your PC to retouch it
app.retocar.carril: What gets retouched · drag the handles, or draw a new span here
app.retocar.citar.tooltip: Put this tag in the prompt, at the cursor
app.retocar.falta.prompt: Write the prompt: how the covered area should look.
app.retocar.falta.rect: Draw the rectangle on the video.
app.retocar.falta.texto: Write what to look for (for example, face).
app.retocar.falta.video: First put a video on the timeline.
app.retocar.listo: Retouch ready in {s} s: the timeline now has the new full video
app.retocar.mascara.rect.ayuda: Draw the area you want to change on the video with the mouse. It is covered for the whole segment.
app.retocar.mascara.rect.ayuda_hecho: Drag inside to move it and the corners to adjust it; drag outside to draw a new one.
app.retocar.mascara.texto.ayuda: One or two English words (face, hand, hair…). SAM 3.1 finds it and tracks it through the segment. If it can't find something (stylised letters, an effect), use the rectangle.
app.retocar.mejorar.boton.tooltip: Runs the whole video through the effects that are on and saves a new one (the original does not change; the audio is copied as is)
app.retocar.mejorar.falta: Turn on at least one effect: Super Resolution or HDR
app.retocar.mejorar.hdr.aviso: Looks right on HDR screens and phones.
app.retocar.mejorar.hdr.ayuda: Converts the video to HDR (BT.2020/HLG, 10-bit) with NVIDIA RTX: brighter highlights and richer color. It shows on HDR screens and phones; on a normal screen it may look duller.
app.retocar.mejorar.listo: Video enhanced in {s} s: the timeline already has it
app.retocar.mejorar.sr.ayuda: Makes the video bigger and sharper with NVIDIA RTX AI (cleaner edges, hair and textures). It does not invent new things: it only refines what is there. It is fast: a few seconds.
app.retocar.mejorar.sr.no_cabe: {w} × {h} does not fit in memory with this video: pick a smaller size
app.retocar.mejorar.todo: The whole video is enhanced: {s} s · {f} frames
app.retocar.prompt.arrastra: Drag a reference into the prompt to cite it: its <Picture N> is written where you drop it.
app.retocar.prompt.ayuda: Describe how the covered area should look and cite each reference with its <Picture N>.
app.retocar.prompt.placeholder: The young woman is exactly the character in <Picture 2>… the logo from <Picture 1> glows on screen…
app.retocar.recorte.ayuda: Drag the box and its edges to keep only the part you need (with Ctrl, it grows from the centre). “✕ no crop” uses the whole image.
app.retocar.refs.ayuda: Give an image of everything that must appear in the covered area: if you cover a person, their photo. Drag a reference into the prompt (or click its tag) to cite it.
app.retocar.refs.proyecto.tooltip: Pick a reference from this project's Stack (its original photo is used)
app.retocar.refs.sin_stack: This project has no photos in the Stack: upload an image.
app.retocar.refs.subir.tooltip: Upload an image from the PC (goes to ComfyUI/input/max_editor/retocar/refs)
app.retocar.regla.tooltip: Tap or drag to go to that moment of the video
app.retocar.reproductor.mascara_ocultar: Hide the rectangle (to see the detail)
app.retocar.reproductor.solo.tooltip: Play only the chosen span (handle to handle)
app.retocar.resolucion.ayuda: The estimated time below already counts the resolution.
app.retocar.resolucion.mp: The crop around the mask, at about {mp} MP
app.retocar.resolucion.tooltip: The size at which H3 redoes the masked area: the crop around the mask is scaled to these megapixels (multiples of 32). More resolution, more detail and more minutes.
app.retocar.semilla.tooltip: The retouch seed: the same seed gives the same result
app.retocar.sin_video: No video yet: press Generate, or pick one in «Videos» › «Send to Retouch».
app.retocar.sub.mejorar.ayuda: NVIDIA RTX Super Resolution and HDR, on the whole video
app.retocar.sub.tapar.ayuda: Redo a zone with H3 (mask, references and prompt)
app.retocar.todo.tooltip: Select the whole clip to touch it up
app.retocar.tramo.aviso_largo: Long segment: it will take about {lo}–{hi} min.
app.retocar.tramo.aviso_memoria: Long segment ({s} s): it will take about {lo}–{hi} min and may not fit in 12 GB (an RTX 3060 fits about 8 s at 0.4 MP or 5 s at 1 MP).
app.retocar.vacio: Side B has no tape: no video yet
app.retocar.ver.ayuda: See which area will be redone before touching up: the mask is computed as in the touch-up, without generating.
app.retocar.ver.listo: The segment with the area that will be redone in pink (mask computed in {s} s, no H3).
app.salud.tooltip: What the app needs: ComfyUI (makes the video), the proxy (the Comfy SDK talks to it) and the local LLM (writes the story and the shots)
app.semilla.otra.tooltip: Pick a random seed (for the next time you press Generate)
app.semilla.tooltip: H3's roll of the dice. The same seed and prompt give the same video; if it comes out wrong, try another seed before changing the prompt
app.videos.carpeta.tooltip: Open the videos folder (app/salidas) in the file manager
app.videos.extender.tooltip: Open this video in «Extend video» to make it longer, continuing the same shot
app.videos.retocar.tooltip: Put this video on the «Retouch the video» timeline (at the very bottom)
app.videos.retomar.aqui.tooltip: Replaces what this project has now with that video's (what is there now is lost)
app.videos.retomar.copia.tooltip: Creates a new project with that video's settings; this project does not change
app.videos.retomar.hecho: Prompt reused from the video of {fecha} (seed {semilla})
app.videos.retomar.hecho_copia: Prompt reused in the new project «{proyecto}» (video of {fecha}, seed {semilla})
app.videos.retomar.origen: It is a retouch, an extension or an enhancement: the prompt of the Generate video it came from is reused.
app.videos.retomar.sin: This video was made before the app saved its prompt (Oct 29): it cannot be reused
app.videos.retomar.tooltip: Loads again the prompt, shots, references and seed this video was generated with, as a starting point
app.videos.tooltip: The videos you made in this project
app.videos.vacio: No videos in this project yet: press Generate.
audio.anadir: Add a song or reference audio
audio.anadir.sub: Pick one from input/, upload it from your PC or drop it here
audio.anadir.tooltip: Choose a song or reference audio: H3 follows it and the cuts land on its beats
audio.ayuda: drag the waveform: slow = fine, fast = far · wheel or ←/→ = 1 frame · Shift = 1 s
audio.barra.tooltip: The whole song: drag the white dot (or click the line) to jump
audio.cambiar.tooltip: Pick another song from input/ or upload one from your PC
audio.canciones.ayuda: The audio files in input/ (the ones LoadAudio sees). Click one to use it, or upload one: you can also drop the file onto this window. When you change it, the segment goes back to the start and the beats are the new song's.
audio.no_es_audio: That isn't an audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg, m4a…)
audio.onda.tooltip: Drag to move the song (slow = fine, fast = far) · wheel or ←/→ = 1 frame · Shift+arrow = 1 s · space = play or pause
audio.play.tooltip: Play just this segment (stops on its own at the end)
audio.sin_audio: No audio connected: cuts are evenly spaced.
comun.candado: Locked: the LLM won't change it
comun.idea_ayuda: What happens and in what tone, in your own words (overrides everything else)
comun.idioma.tooltip: Window language (it is the ComfyUI setting “Edit prompt › Language”)
comun.migracion.efectos: The recipe effects no longer exist; I removed them from {tomas}. Create your own with “+ Effect” (on the blue side) or write the effect phrase in the shot.
comun.migracion.receta: This workflow used the recipe “{receta}”, which no longer exists: enter the character's name and description (in its reference) and the Style (in the overall story).
comun.ventana.autoguardado.tooltip: Every change is saved in the node about 2 s after you stop typing. To save the workflow to disk, Ctrl+S.
comun.ventana.autoguardado_faltan.detall: Fields not written in the prompt (H3 doesn't get them): {lista}
comun.ventana.duracion_igual: the workflow already had that length
errores.audio_no_esta: can't find the audio “{audio}” in input/
errores.cajita_pocas_fotos: A pack needs at least 2 photos.
errores.cola.buscar_sam: ComfyUI is busy: wait for the queue to finish before searching with SAM.
errores.cola.crear_cajita: ComfyUI is busy: wait for the queue to finish before creating the pack.
errores.cola.crear_subidas: ComfyUI is busy: wait for the queue to finish before creating the references.
errores.cola.crear_tapada: ComfyUI is busy: wait for the queue to finish before creating the covered reference.
errores.cola_llm: ComfyUI is busy: wait for the queue to finish before using the LLM.
errores.llm_no_responde: The LLM isn't responding at {url} (service llama-qwen38: systemctl --user start llama-qwen38).
errores.modo_no_vale: That mode doesn't exist (compressed or full).
errores.no_se_pudo.mascaras: Couldn't make the masks with SAM 3.1: {detalle}
errores.palabras_falta_arroba: words: missing '@ shot' in “{linea}” (example: TO YOU @1)
errores.palabras_no_vale: words: “{linea}” isn't valid (the shot goes from 1 to {n}, or @last)
errores.refmod_existe: A RefMod “{nombre}” already exists: pick another name.
errores.revision: {paso}: {n} attempts failed the review. Last problems: {problemas}. Details in {carpeta}
errores.sin_foto: {nombre}: can't find its original photo or its preview
errores.sin_fuente: {nombre} doesn't know which file it came from: only references uploaded from this window can change mode.
errores.subir_sin_fotos: There are no photos to upload.
errores.subir_sin_nombre: Give it a short name (e.g. teto, red_jacket).
errores.subir_video_solo: A video goes alone in its reference: it can't be grouped with photos.
errores.tapar.cajita_sin_fotos: {original} is a pack of {n} photos without its photos recorded: I can't cover all of it. Recreate it with “Change photos” and then cover it.
errores.tapar.elige: Choose what to cover: face, hair, text, or type something else in English (hat, logo…).
errores.tapar.nada: SAM didn't find anything you asked to cover ({palabras}): no covered copy created.
errores.tarda.crear_cajita: Taking too long ({min} min) to create the pack; check the ComfyUI console.
errores.tarda.crear_subidas: Taking too long ({min} min) to create the reference; check the ComfyUI console.
errores.tarda.crear_tapada: Taking too long ({min} min) to create the covered reference; check the ComfyUI console.
errores.tarda.mascaras: Taking too long ({min} min) to make the masks with SAM 3.1; check the ComfyUI console.
errores.tomas_no_caben: {n} shots don't fit in {dur} s (each shot needs at least 0.4 s).
errores.traducir: I could not translate it without errors in 3 tries (your text was not changed). Last problems: {problemas}. Details in {carpeta}
final.ayuda: The code rebuilds it on every change, without calling the LLM. Hover over a reference to see where it's used.
final.escribir_tomas.tooltip: Framing, light, action and camera for every shot (about 30 s). Keeps anything with the lock.
final.frases.ayuda: {c} is filled with that data; {cp} uses the word if the data is empty; what goes between [[ and ]] only appears if its data is not empty. Empty a phrase so it doesn't appear. The back button restores the default.
final.frases.titulo: Code phrases · the only thing the code adds to the prompt
final.frases.tooltip: Everything the code puts between what you and the LLM write. You can change each phrase.
final.hueco.cortes_a_mano: the manual cuts don't fit the duration: using the automatic ones
final.mostrar.tooltip: The whole prompt H3 receives, colored by who wrote each part
final.origen.codigo.tooltip: A code joining phrase (frases.json). Click it to change it.
final.origen.frase: Phrase “{clave}” ({de}). Click it to change it.
final.origen.llm.tooltip: The LLM wrote it and it isn't locked
final.origen.molde.tooltip: What the H3 format needs: sections, tags and times
final.origen.tu.tooltip: You wrote it (or locked it with the lock)
final.plan_vacio: The plan is empty: press “Write story” and then “Write shots”, or fill in the fields yourself.
linea.anadir.tooltip: Add a shot (the others get narrower)
linea.audio.ayuda: Your song: the video plays the audio you chose (H3 only uses it as a guide). H3 audio: the sound the model generates.
linea.audio.sin_cancion: No song: the video plays the audio H3 makes from «Sound». Write there what it should sound like.
linea.ayuda: Click a shot to see its prompt · drag an edge to change how long they last · + adds one
linea.borde.tooltip: Drag to lengthen one shot and shorten the other
linea.cortes_auto.tooltip: Forget the manual cuts and put them back on the beats
linea.cortes_auto_listo: Automatic cuts: on the beats, evenly spread
linea.duracion.tooltip: Drag right to make it longer and left to make it shorter, or click to type it. H3 only makes 17·k + 5 frames: it snaps to the nearest valid value.
linea.no_partir: The last shot can't be split: back to automatic cuts
linea.pegar.tooltip: When you let go of an edge, it snaps to the nearest beat (±0.15 s)
linea.sonido.placeholder: empty: Only the music of <Audio 1>, unchanged, with no dialogue and no added sound effects.
linea.sonido.placeholder_sin: No song: describe in English how the video sounds (e.g. soft rain and a slow piano). Empty: natural sound that matches what happens, no dialogue.
linea.sonido.tooltip: In English: goes as is to overall_soundscape (e.g. whooshes and impact hits accent each cut and word). Empty: only the music, no sound effects
nodo.audio.tooltip: The workflow's LoadAudio: cuts land on its beats. Without audio, cuts are evenly spaced.
nodo.descripcion: Idea → H3 prompt. With “Open editor…” you see and link the references, the prompt the LLM reads and the final prompt. Without the editor, Qwen3.8 writes the story and every shot from the node's fields. Docs: custom_nodes/edit_prompt_llm/PLANOS.md
nodo.duracion_s.tooltip: Frames / 24; same as the Prompt Builder's duration
nodo.informe.bloqueado: Locked text: goes out as is, no LLM.
nodo.informe.del_editor_a_mano: Prompt from the editor (edited by hand)
nodo.informe.llamadas: {n} calls in {total} s (story {historia} s, shots {tomas} s)
nodo.informe.reutilizado: Reused from disk (same inputs and seed): {carpeta}
nodo.informe.revision_limpia: everything passed on the first try
nodo.informe.vram_aviso: WARNING: llama didn't release the VRAM within {s} s
nodo.palabras.placeholder: Optional · one per line: TEXT @ shot (or @last). E.g.: TO YOU @1
nodo.semilla_llm.tooltip: New seed = new version; same seed = same prompt, without calling the LLM
nodo.texto_bloqueado.placeholder: Optional · paste a prompt here and it goes out as is, without calling the LLM
referencias.a_principal: {nombre} moves to Main: it counts in every shot
referencias.a_secundarias: {nombre} moves to Secondary: connect it to the shots that use it
referencias.aviso.copias: {nombre}: has copies; numbering may not match the Text Encode
referencias.aviso.fotos: {n} active photos: H3 accepts 9 at most
referencias.aviso.sin_prompt_builder: The node isn't connected to a Prompt Builder: using the workflow's first RefMod Stack.
referencias.aviso.sin_stack: No RefMod Stack or Media Loader found: there are no references to link.
referencias.aviso.videos: {n} active videos (or packs): H3 accepts 3 at most
referencias.biblioteca.ayuda_corta: Tap photos to mark them; for several photos in one reference, use «Box».
referencias.biblioteca.papel.tooltip: The role the marked photos get. «Its own»: the one it already had in the editor or, if new, the one from its RefMod concept
referencias.cajita.apagar_sueltas: turn off in the Stack the single references I put in the pack
referencias.cajita.ayuda: Click a photo to add or remove it. The first one sets the size of the rest.
referencias.cajita.cambiar.tooltip: Opens the creator with these photos; once created, the new one takes this one's place in the Stack
referencias.cajita.creada: Pack {nombre} created in {s} s and added to the Stack
referencias.cajita.creada_como: Pack {nombre} created in {s} s and added to the Stack as {tag}
referencias.cajita.no_en_biblioteca: {nombre} was created but isn't in the library
referencias.cajita.nombre: Name (of the character, object, place, clothes or effect)
referencias.cajita.resumen: Pack “{nombre}” · {n} photos · H3 gets it as {tag}
referencias.cajita.sin_apuntar: This pack has {n} photos, but they weren't recorded: only the first one shows. If you recreate it with “Change photos”, they'll be recorded.
referencias.cajita.titulo_cambiar: Change the photos of “{nombre}” (a new pack is created)
referencias.cajita.titulo_nueva: New pack: several photos in one reference
referencias.clip.sin_video: Clip without its source video: showing its first frame.
referencias.conectar.principal: It is in Main: it already counts in every shot.
referencias.conectar.quitar: Already in shot {k}: click to remove it
referencias.conectar.tooltip: Connect {tag} to a shot (or drag it onto the shot)
referencias.der.titulo: Borrowed · clothes, poses, backgrounds, style and effects
referencias.der.vacio: Clothes, poses, backgrounds and styles taken only in some shots.
referencias.efecto.anadir.tooltip: An effect with no image: a name and a phrase that goes into the prompt as is
referencias.efecto.ayuda: An effect with no image: the LLM can put it in the shots where it fits and the code pastes the phrase as is. For an effect with an example image or clip, add the reference and give it the “effect” role.
referencias.efecto.frase: Effect phrase (in English; goes into the prompt as is)
referencias.efecto.frase.placeholder: e.g. thin neon light streaks cross the frame behind <Subject 1>
referencias.efecto.tocar: Click to edit or remove it
referencias.efecto.tocar_toma: Click to add it to or remove it from the selected shot
referencias.en_todas_ya: {nombre} is in Main: it already counts in every shot
referencias.ficha.apagada.tooltip: When off, it isn't sent to H3 and has no number
referencias.ficha.atuendo.placeholder: only if this photo is an outfit: school uniform
referencias.ficha.describir.tooltip: Qwen looks at the image and suggests a description and risks; check it
referencias.ficha.ficha: Description: what's visible (in English; the LLM can't see the image)
referencias.ficha.ficha_efecto: Description: the effect phrase that goes into the prompt as is (in English)
referencias.ficha.ficha_personaje: Description: what the character looks like (in English; goes into its definition)
referencias.ficha.personaje.ayuda: Each character is a subject (<Subject 1>, <Subject 2>…): the code writes its definition and retention from the name, pronoun and description. Photos with the same name are the same character. With an outfit, the photo is also an outfit and each shot picks one (its description covers those clothes).
referencias.gestor.soltar: Drop your photos or a video here
referencias.gestor.sub_der: What you add here is lent to some shots. Tap several and press «Add».
referencias.gestor.sub_izq: What you add here counts in every shot. Tap several and press «Add».
referencias.gestor.subir.ayuda: Click or drop photos or a video from your PC here: you can crop them before creating the RefMod.
referencias.gestor.subir.tooltip: Pick photos or a video from your PC
referencias.hueco.der: to Secondary: connected to some shots
referencias.hueco.izq: to Main: counts in every shot
referencias.hueco.tooltip: Opens the RefMod manager: upload photos or a video, or pick the ones you already have. You can also drop files here.
referencias.izq.vacio: Put here whatever must always look the same: the character (a pack with their photos), a product or a place. Use “+ Add” or “+ Pack”, or change a reference's role.
referencias.no_caben: They don't fit: the Stack has {hay} of 12 cards and you're adding {n}. Unselect {sobran} or remove cards from the Stack.
referencias.nombre.efecto: short effect name (e.g. neon light streaks)
referencias.nombre.objeto: object name in the prompt (e.g. red soda can)
referencias.nombre.personaje: character name (e.g. Teto); photos with the same name are the same character
referencias.principal.ayuda: Counts in every shot: the prompt cites it in each one.
referencias.propuesta_lista: {tag}: suggestion ready in {s} s. Use it or discard it.
referencias.recorte.aplicado: {nombre} rebuilt with the new crop in {s} s
referencias.recorte.aplicando: Rebuilding the reference with the new crop…
referencias.renglon.sin_frase: (no line: its role has no phrase)
referencias.renglones: Its lines at the top of the prompt
referencias.renglones.ayuda: Left empty, the code uses its role's phrase (shown in gray). What you write here goes in as is.
referencias.secundarias.ayuda: Only goes in the shots you connect it to.
referencias.subir.ayuda: They're saved to input/minimax_h3/ and the RefMod to the chosen folder (about 5–10 s each, plus about 15 s if covered).
referencias.subir.carpeta.nueva.placehol: name of the new folder (e.g. demo characters)
referencias.subir.creada: Created {nombres} in {s} s and added to the Stack
referencias.subir.creadas: Created {nombres} in {s} s and added to the Stack
referencias.subir.juntar: put the {n} photos together in one pack (the same character or object)
referencias.subir.modo.completo.tooltip: Keeps the detail (faces, clothes, lettering). Heavier: for a clip, better a short one.
referencias.subir.modo.comprimido.toolti: Copies the overall look (style, colors, rhythm) and weighs much less. To copy the style of an edit (the reel method).
referencias.subir.no_caben: They don't fit: the Stack has {hay} of 12 cards.
referencias.subir.no_es_imagen: That isn't an image or a video
referencias.subir.nombre: Short name (goes into the prompt and the RefMod)
referencias.subir.nombre_personaje: Character name (short; also the RefMod's name)
referencias.subir.tapar: cover on upload: face and hair, with SAM 3.1 (so whoever is in the photo doesn't slip in)
referencias.subir.tooltip: Create new references from photos or a video on your PC
referencias.subir.vacio: Click here to pick photos or a video from your PC, or drop them on this window.
referencias.subir.video.ayuda: The video is saved to input/minimax_h3/ and the clip RefMod to the chosen folder, with its crop, span and mode. It takes about 15–40 s; you'll see it moving in its card.
referencias.subir.video.recorte_ayuda: With “✂ Crop”, the yellow box marks what is used: drag a side or a corner to move it, Ctrl + drag to resize it whole, and from inside to move it.
referencias.vacia.tooltip: Click to upload a photo or a video from your PC
resolucion.tooltip: Video size: width and height (multiples of 32) and megapixels (0.1 to 2). Applied at once to the Text Encode.
tapar.aplicar.tooltip: Creates (or reuses) the covered copy with these options and puts it in the Stack
tapar.aviso.previa: Using the RefMod preview ({w}×{h}, lower resolution than a photo): couldn't find its original photo in input/minimax_h3. If you have it, put it there as “{tronco}.jpg” and turn “cover” on again.
tapar.interruptor.tooltip: Covers the chosen parts of the photo with SAM 3.1 and uses that copy in the Stack. Off brings back the original.
tapar.libre.placeholder: something else, in English: hat, logo
tapar.origen.foto: its original photo {ruta} ({w}×{h}, same name as the RefMod)
tapar.para_que: so the face of whoever wears the clothes or strikes the pose doesn't slip in
tapar.previa.tooltip: Shows how it looks, without creating the reference
tapar.reutilizo: Reusing {nombre}: already covered with these options (no SAM) · {s} s
tapar.stack_cambio: The Stack changed while covering: reopen the reference
tapar.tapada: Covered in {s} s (SAM {sam} s, RefMod {refmod} s) · {encontrado}
tapar.vuelve_original: Back to the original ({original}); the covered copy is kept for next time.
texto.anadir.tooltip: Add an on-screen word, on the beat nearest to the start of the selected shot
texto.ayuda: double-click an empty spot to add · drag a word to move it · drag its right edge to make it last longer · click it to change it
texto.campo.placeholder: the word, as it appears: RISE
texto.etiqueta.tooltip: «{texto}» · {a}–{b} s · click to change it, drag to move it
texto.fin.tooltip: Drag to make it last longer or shorter
texto.fin_auto: until the end of its shot
texto.frase.placeholder: glowing electric-blue neon script with small stars
texto.letra.fuerza.tooltip: The strength of its card in the Stack. 0.5 by default: so the lettering comes through, not the words written in it
texto.letra.ninguna: no reference: the phrase describes the lettering
texto.letra.quitar.tooltip: The word stops using this reference (the card stays in the Stack)
texto.sitio.al_lado.tooltip: Beside the person, never covering the face (as in Teto)
texto.sitio.encima.tooltip: Huge, over the close-up, with the face still visible behind the letters (as in Ren)
texto.tiempo: Starts at {a} s and lasts until {b} s
toma.camara.mio.placeholder: in English, after “the camera …” (e.g. slowly orbits around her)
toma.efecto.mas.tooltip: Connect another reference to this shot
toma.efecto.quitar.tooltip: Remove this reference from the shot
toma.encuadre.mio.placeholder: in English, exactly as it goes into the prompt (e.g. high-angle full shot)
toma.entorno.auto.tooltip: The LLM picks the place for this shot. If you type it yourself, it switches to manual
toma.entorno.manual.tooltip: You write the place and it stays fixed: the LLM won't change it
toma.entorno.ninguno.ayuda: no setting: no place or background is written
toma.entorno.ninguno.tooltip: For when the surroundings don't matter and you only want to highlight an object or a person
toma.estilo.placeholder: empty: the style of the reference images (flat 2D anime illustration…)
toma.frase.arroba: type @ or tap one to cite it:
toma.frase.creado: Effect {id} created: it now shows on the blue side
toma.frase.de_ficha: if you write nothing, each reference's description goes in
toma.frase.guardar_como.tooltip: Saves this phrase as a reusable text effect (it shows up on the blue side)
toma.frase.placeholder: in English: what each reference does; type @ to cite one
toma.frase.sin_conectadas: Connect a reference above first, with +
toma.frase.volver: Back to the descriptions of the connected references
toma.gesto.ayuda: what the character does, in English (e.g. raises the lollipop next to her cheek)
toma.linea.tooltip: This shot's line in the final prompt. Click it to see it all.
toma.luz.ayuda: the light of this shot, in English (e.g. warm golden backlight)
toma.momento.ayuda: in English: what happens in the scene; if you write it, it goes into the shot's prompt
toma.quitar.tooltip: Remove this shot from the edit
toma.refs.ayuda: What this shot uses lights up above, on the shelf; drag a poster here to connect it.
toma.rehacer.tooltip: Rewrite this shot's framing, light, action and camera (about 7 s), looking at its neighbors
toma.sin_linea: (no line yet: write the story and the shots, or fill in the fields)
toma.sin_refs: No per-shot references to pick (identity and style apply to every shot).
toma.vacio: Pick a shot on the timeline to see and edit its prompt.
traducir.boton.tooltip: Translates this whole field from {idioma} into English with the local LLM. Ctrl+Z brings your text back. For a part: select it and right click.
traducir.campo_cambio: The field changed while translating: nothing was touched. Try again.
traducir.desde.tooltip: The language you write in: the «Translate to English» button and the right click turn it into English (what H3 reads)
traducir.desde_titulo: Which language do you write in?
traducir.listo: Translated from {idioma} in {s} s · Ctrl+Z brings your text back
traducir.menu.ayuda: Ctrl+Z undoes · Shift + right click: the normal menu
traducir.menu.todo: Translate the whole field to English
traducir.siempre_ingles: It always translates into English, which is what H3 reads.
traducir.sin_resultados: None in the list: type it below.
traducir.vacio: There is no text to translate.
traducir.ya: Already translating another field: wait a moment.
